capabilities: Edit notes in a block-based rich text view with 34 block, inline, and adjustment tools
Convert between Editor.js blocks and Markdown in both directions
Reorder blocks by drag and drop
Undo, redo, and auto-save edits back to the Markdown file
Open any Markdown file in the rich text view via context menu or command palette
extras: README is written in Chinese. Notes that some third-party Editor.js plugins use eval(), recommends editing large documents (100+ blocks) in sections, and says the layout tool may need style tweaks on some themes.
problem: Obsidian's built-in editor is Markdown-source based and offers no block-style visual editing mode.
summary: Block-based rich text editor powered by Editor.js that opens Markdown files in a WYSIWYG view with 34 editing tools and Markdown round-trip conversion.
